result.brief: 提出原生具身世界系统 Innata-0，联合设计三塔世界-动作模型与具备记忆、验证、恢复能力的智能体，并通过协同设计协议对齐训练与执行。
result.reason: Embodied world-action model with tri-tower understanding/prediction/action architecture and agent co-design; main contribution is embodied world modeling and robotic manipulation, fitting the applications direction.
